goal: Land the seven low-blast-radius production guards (P1, P2, P3, P5, P6, P7, P10): crash-proof the zernio ingest failed-hook, bound the Supabase admin/storage client fetch, retry transient guardrail-regen failures, attach non-fatal 'error' listeners to BullMQ Workers/Queues and the probe Redis client, bound Fastify ingress timeouts and body size, close the generate_response and inbound_events health-alert blind spots, and let the dashboard degrade per-widget.
non_goals: P8 Stripe timeouts under the tier-change locks (follow-up branch; named precedents are stale and must be re-anchored)
P9 explicit BullMQ concurrency + LLM circuit breaker (follow-up branch)
Schema changes, new env vars, or migrations
Dashboard DTO/type changes or frontend null-guards — degraded widgets return empty-but-valid shapes
user_visible_behavior: Dashboard renders with empty widget states instead of a 500 when any of the 12 auxiliary queries fails; business lookup failures keep existing error semantics
A transient LLM/infra failure during the avoid-facts guardrail regen retries the job instead of silently dropping the owner's paid draft

Operational: worker survives Redis blips and failed-hook bookkeeping errors; health alerts fire for terminal generate_response failures and failed inbound webhook events; ingress rejects slow-loris/oversized requests
invariants: Transactional outbox semantics unchanged; markOutboxFailed/markOutboxCompleted call sites keep their meaning
Budget/cost-cap decisions stay TERMINAL; only transient transport/infra errors become retryable (P3 owner decision extends this to the guardrail regen lane)
Degradation is never silent: every degraded widget and swallowed emitter error reports to Sentry/structured logs
No raw review/response text, tokens, or secrets in logs
Error listeners and last-resort catch blocks must themselves never throw
Happy-path dashboard response is behavior-identical to today
edge_cases: Best-effort markOutboxFailed itself throwing inside the P1 crash guard
Sentry captureMessage throwing inside the P5 error listener
Caller-provided AbortSignal composed with the P2 timeout via AbortSignal.any
Regenerated draft violating the guardrail again stays terminal guardrail_failed
inbound_events check groups by source so one noisy provider doesn't mask another
queues.ts import stays side-effect-light (one listener per queue, no I/O at import)
existing_patterns_to_follow: health-alert checks.ts check shape + emitHealthFindings sink (P7)
dashboard service readPendingMarker try/catch-to-null degrade shape (P10)
tests_to_add: ingest-failed-hook crash-guard: resolves + Sentry capture when INSERT throws; resolves when markOutboxFailed also throws
boundedSupabaseFetch: attaches timeout signal; rejects within bound
guardrail regen error matrix: TransientLLMError/CostInfraUnavailableError/ConcurrencyLimitExceededError re-throw; violation-persists stays terminal
attachEmitterErrorLogger: consumes error events without throwing; survives Sentry capture throwing
health checks: generate_response topic finding; checkFailedInboundEvents per-source findings + quiet when healthy; runHealthChecks includes new check
dashboard degradation: auxiliary rejection degrades + reports; business rejection still throws; all-healthy path unchanged
